facts.fact: The Countdown to 2030 synthesis report analyses national health facility data from DHIS2 for 2019-2024 across provinces and districts, and refers to the MoHCC HMIS.
The Countdown to 2030 report says the national reporting rate for 2024 was above 92%, with only Harare and Bulawayo provinces just below the threshold.
